title: Feature Anchoring with Replay and Knowledge Distillation for Class-Incremental Continual Learning
domain: Continual Learning · Knowledge Distillation · Catastrophic Forgetting
abstract: Proposed FACL/FAKD, a lightweight tri-level continual-learning framework combining class-balanced replay, layer-4 feature anchoring, logit distillation, and diagonal-Fisher EWC to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. Outperformed DER++ by +12.61% and reduced forgetting by 21.27 points across 5 seeds on Split-CIFAR-100.
course: 1st Author · Amrita School of Computing · Accepted, CIS 2026

title: Verification-Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Reliable Semiconductor Device Physics Reasoning
domain: Neuro-Symbolic AI · RAG · Physics Reasoning · SLMs
abstract: Built a neuro-symbolic RAG pipeline combining LoRA-fine-tuned Qwen2.5-0.5B with FAISS/BM25/RRF hybrid retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, and a three-stage SymPy validator for symbolic, dimensional, and numerical verification. Outperformed ungrounded 70B-parameter baseline by +135% on hard physics reasoning.
course: 1st Author · Amrita School of Computing · Submitted to EAAI

title: Nexus — LLM-Driven Autonomous Self-Healing Distributed Task Queue
abstract: Designed a capability-aware distributed task queue with Redis-backed priority queues, DAG workflow execution, persistent task state, database-hydration crash recovery, and sandboxed worker execution. LLM-driven AIOps reliability engine achieves 91.2% autonomous remediation across 12 fault categories.
course: Conference Research Project · Paper Ready for Submission

title: Multi-Stage Toxicity Prediction for Drug Discovery Using Fingerprints, GNNs & Knowledge Graph Neural Networks
abstract: Five-stage cooperative learning pipeline addressing extreme label sparsity (<0.5% labeled). Integrates Morgan fingerprint initialization, GIN, data-driven Knowledge Graph construction, and ensemble fusion. Validated on 79,002 molecules from ZINC, ChEMBL, and Tox21.

title: Predicting Dominant Gamete Contribution in Fertilization Using Genomic & Phenotypic Characteristics
abstract: Novel hybrid AI-bioinformatics pipeline predicting gamete dominance in fertilization. Integrates WHO semen data, SHBG synthetic SNPs, and oocyte transcriptomic profiles (GSE107746). Random Forest achieves 92% accuracy (ROC-AUC 0.94). SHAP reveals BMP15, GDF9, ZP3 as primary drivers.
